## How I tested it

- [ ] `npm run format:check`, `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm test`
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test` (in `src-tauri`)
- [ ] Ran the app and checked idle, peek and expanded (dark and light)
- [ ] UI change: screenshot or clip attached
- [ ] Notch behavior: tested on a real notch / with `NOTCH_SIM=1` / not applicable

## Checklist

- [ ] No new network hosts (or CSP + README updated and justified)
- [ ] No secrets in logs, errors or the UI
- [ ] `docs/DESIGN.md` updated if sizes or timings changed
